name: Sleeping With The Werewolf And The Vampire
source:
You and your sexy werewolf partner, Lucas, have only one goal: Kill Dracula and every last vampire. But neither of you expected a seductive vampire, Cassandra, to tempt you with an offer you can't refuse! Can you handle falling into bed with a werewolf AND a vampire?

[From in-app]
translation:
你和你性感的狼人搭档卢卡斯只有一个目标：杀死德古拉和每一个吸血鬼。但你们谁也没想到一个诱人的吸血鬼卡桑德拉会用一个你无法拒绝的提议来诱惑你！你能应付与狼人和吸血鬼一起上床吗？

[来自应用程序内]
